text: {"reply":"I need to correct my colleague's earlier message. I can't confirm that the vehicle will be ready Thursday, and I can't confirm that the brake repair is done. The repair order shows the vehicle is waiting for parts. It doesn't say which part or give an ETA. The reason for the visit on the order also doesn't match what you described. Because of that, I'm passing this to a person at the branch. They will check the order and the delivery date, and they can confirm whether the account holder has authorised you to receive details on this fleet vehicle. For now, please don't count on Thursday for your delivery route. I can't set up text updates myself. I've noted that you want a text rather than a message to the driver.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"tool_failure","summary":"Customer asked for status of a repair order for a fleet vehicle and whether it will be ready Thursday. A colleague's earlier message gave a ready date and repair details that the system does not support. The system shows the order as waiting for parts, with no part or ETA, and with a different complaint from the one the customer described. The customer says they are acting for a company, and the vehicle is a fleet vehicle, so please check their authorisation and confirm the real status and date. The customer asked to be contacted by text, not through the driver.","policy_rules_cited":["P05","P08","P12","P14","P15"]}
